fields.name: width
fields.description: Width in terminal cells.

fields.name: height
fields.description: Height in terminal cells.

fields.name: pattern
fields.description: 0 solid; 1 linear; 2 diagonal; 3 wave; 4 rotating linear; 5 plasma; 6 concentric; 7 moire; 8 aurora; 9 interference; 10 chevrons; 11 diamond.

fields.name: focusMode
fields.description: 0 none; 1 row; 2 column; 3 radial; 4 diagonal band.

fields.name: focusX
fields.description: Focus x in Q8 cells (256 = one column).

fields.name: focusY
fields.description: Focus y in Q8 cells.

fields.name: periodMs
fields.description: Color field cycle in milliseconds.

fields.name: saturation
fields.description: Color saturation in thousandths.

fields.name: brightness
fields.description: Field brightness blended from base, in thousandths.

fields.name: speedFalloff
fields.description: Speed multiplier for each cell away from focus.

fields.name: saturationFalloff
fields.description: Saturation multiplier per cell away from focus.

fields.name: brightnessFalloff
fields.description: Brightness multiplier per cell away from focus.

fields.name: cellAspect
fields.description: Cell height / width in thousandths; circles compensate for this.

fields.name: scale
fields.description: Gradient wavelength in Q8 cells.

fields.name: angle
fields.description: Gradient angle in millidegrees.

fields.name: pivotX
fields.description: Rotation axis x in Q8 cells; may lie offscreen.

fields.name: pivotY
fields.description: Rotation axis y in Q8 cells; may lie offscreen.

fields.name: rotationPeriodMs
fields.description: Independent axis rotation / pendulum period.

fields.name: rotationMode
fields.description: 0 fixed axis; 1 continuous rotation; 2 eased pendulum.

fields.name: swing
fields.description: Pendulum half-amplitude in millidegrees.

fields.name: phase
fields.description: Color phase in 1/1024 turns.

fields.name: pixelMode
fields.description: 0 whole cell; 1 upper/lower half; 2 left/right half; 3 braille dither.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Deterministic seed. Stable under resize.

fields.name: baseColor
fields.description: Opaque bottom color, packed RGB.

fields.name: inkColor
fields.description: Default foreground, packed RGB.

fields.name: paletteCount
fields.description: Number of configured gradient colors (binding-managed).

fields.name: gradientWrap
fields.description: 0 seamless loop; 1 mirrored forward/back; 2 hard cyclic stops.

fields.name: interpolation
fields.description: 0 encoded RGB linear; 1 eased RGB interpolation.

fields.name: colorMode
fields.description: 0 palette; 1 full HSV wheel; 2 three phase-separated RGB sine channels.

fields.name: hueOffset
fields.description: Hue-wheel offset in degrees.

fields.name: stars
fields.description: Enable stable-glyph twinkling stars.

fields.name: starDensity
fields.description: Chance per cell, in thousandths.

fields.name: starMinMs
fields.description: Minimum independent star period.

fields.name: starRangeMs
fields.description: Additional deterministic period range.

fields.name: starDuty
fields.description: Visible portion of a star cycle, in thousandths.

fields.name: starPeak
fields.description: Peak star opacity relative to its configured peak color.

fields.name: starGlyphCount
fields.description: Number of chosen ordinary star glyphs.

fields.name: starColorCount
fields.description: Number of star peak colors.

fields.name: novaChance
fields.description: Per world-tile chance per nova cycle, in thousandths. Zero disables automatic novae.

fields.name: novaCycleMs
fields.description: Stable world-tile nova opportunity cycle.

fields.name: novaDurationMs
fields.description: Nova glyph evolution and shockwave duration.

fields.name: novaGlyphCount
fields.description: Ordered expansion glyph sequence; contracts on fade.

fields.name: rippleSpeed
fields.description: Shockwave propagation in Q8 cells per second.

fields.name: rippleWidth
fields.description: Soft ring thickness in Q8 cells.

fields.name: rippleLifeMs
fields.description: Lifetime of a user/data ripple.

fields.name: rippleOpacity
fields.description: Peak background ring opacity.

fields.name: rippleRings
fields.description: Number of trailing concentric wavefronts.

fields.name: motion
fields.description: 0 evaluates decorative fields at time zero; host pause holds explicit time instead.

fields.name: quantize
fields.description: 0 RGB; 1 canonical ANSI16 approximation; 2 xterm256 approximation.

fields.name: originX
fields.description: World origin x in whole cells; stable sky coordinates.

fields.name: originY
fields.description: World origin y in whole cells.

fields.name: waveAmplitude
fields.description: Wave deformation in thousandths.

fields.name: starAttack
fields.description: Fraction of visible star lifetime used for brightening.

fields.name: reverse
fields.description: Reverse decorative phase and continuous rotation.
